title: Tutorials for Introduction to Modern Statistics
text: recommended way launch tutorials R Tutorials extension VS Code, lists every installed tutorial lets start one click. backup, can launch tutorial R console learnr2::run_tutorial(), providing short name tutorial package name. Hello Data (“01-hello-data”). Chapter 1: stent experiment, cases variables loan50, associations among US counties, experiments versus observational studies. Study Design (“02-study-design”). Chapter 2: populations samples using mlb salaries, simple random stratified sampling, malaria vaccine experiment. Applications: Data (“03-applications-data”). Chapter 3: getting know paralympic_1500, Simpson’s paradox 1500m gold medal times. Exploring Categorical Data (“04-exploring-categorical-data”). Chapter 4: contingency tables, bar plots, conditional proportions loans_full_schema, comparing county incomes across groups. Exploring Numerical Data (“05-exploring-numerical-data”). Chapter 5: histograms, shape, summary statistics loan50, transformations intensity maps county. Histograms (“06-histograms”). Read, make, interpret histograms: bars count, choose bins, center, spread, shape, comparing groups facets, log scale skewed data, using ggplot2::mpg ggplot2::diamonds. Students connect repo gh git, build analysis.qmd go, submit repository URL end.
